name: Quarterfall
description: Radius hollowed out: the same rolled quarter-discs, but half of them keep only their outer band, so filled corners and open ones fall through the grid together.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: circle(100% at 0 0); clip-path: circle(100% at 0 0); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); @random(0.5) { -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0% 0%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0% 0%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
